summary.core_problem: 源分布训练的预测模型泛化到目标分布效果差，因果结构不变性无法仅从源数据识别。
summary.importance: 领域泛化的因果理论分析，提出溯因-演绎分解框架。
summary.technical_approach: 将最优预测分解为溯因映射和演绎映射，利用大规模源数据约束有效映射组合，实现部分识别目标域最优预测。
summary.experiments: 暂无具体实验结果披露。

summary_en.core_problem: Prediction models trained on source distribution generalize poorly to target distribution, and causal structural invariances are not identifiable from source data alone.
summary_en.importance: Causal theoretical analysis for domain generalization with abduction-deduction decomposition framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes optimal prediction into abduction and deduction maps, uses large source data to constrain valid map ensembles, and achieves partially identifiable optimal prediction on target domain.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental results disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 因果视角的领域泛化理论工作，做LLM泛化机制研究可作为理论参考。
recommendation.en: Theoretical work on domain generalization from causal perspective, can be used as theoretical reference for LLM generalization mechanism research.

paper.title: TextTeacher: What Can Language Teach About Images?
paper.abstract: The platonic representation hypothesis suggests that sufficiently large models converge to a shared representation geometry, even across modalities. Motivated by this, we ask: Can the semantic knowledge of a language model efficiently improve a vision model? As an answer, we introduce TextTeacher, a simple auxiliary objective that injects text embeddings as additional information into image classification training. TextTeacher uses readily available image captions, a pre-trained and frozen text

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：在不做大规模图文对比预训练、也不改变推理模型结构的前提下，语言模型中的语义知识能否帮助训练一个纯视觉分类模型。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接价值有限，因为实验主体仍是 ImageNet 分类和 ViT 监督训练，不是通用多模态预训练。但它提供了一个有用的训练信号设计样例：把冻结文本编码器产生的语义嵌入作为训练期的辅助锚点，用来改善视觉表征的早期组织方式。这个思路和 VLM 预训练里的跨模态表征对齐有关，尤其适合思考一个问题：语义先验是否必须通过端到端图文对比学习注入，还是可以作为低成本的 feature-space regularizer 使用。
summary.technical_approach: TextTeacher 的做法很简单。对没有文本标注的 ImageNet，先用预训练 captioning 模型生成图像描述；再用冻结的文本编码器把 caption 编成文本语义 embedding；视觉模型正常做分类训练，同时在视觉 backbone 的表示上接一个轻量 projection，用辅助损失把图像表示拉向对应的文本语义锚点。训练结束后，文本编码器和 projection 都移除，推理时仍是标准 ViT。论文强调 caption 不能只是类别名，最好是简洁但包含额外语义的信息，因为辅助信号需要补充标签和像素中不充分显式的概念，而不是重复监督标签。和传统知识蒸馏相比，它不需要运行大教师模型去输出每张图的 dense logits 或中间特征，也不把目标模型变成图文双塔；它更像是在训练早期给视觉表征提供一个语义坐标系。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在 ImageNet 和若干下游 fine-grained transfer 任务上进行，backbone 是标准 ViT 系列。论文报告在相同训练 recipe 和预算下，ImageNet top-1 accuracy 最高提升 +2.7 个百分点；在 noisy label 设置下提升可达 +8.4 个百分点；Transformer backbone 的迁移任务平均提升约 +1.0 个百分点。效率对比中，TextTeacher 在固定 compute 下优于若干蒸馏基线，或者达到相近/更好精度时只需约 66% 的训练时间。消融结论比较有信息量：辅助文本信号主要在训练早期起作用，更像 feature-space preconditioner；作用位置更多集中在较深层；caption 内容质量和互补性比单纯增加文本长度更关键。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–20 分钟。建议重点看方法部分的 auxiliary alignment loss、caption 构造策略，以及 ablation 中关于训练阶段、层位置、caption 类型和 noisy label 的分析。对预训练研究更有价值的是它如何把冻结语言表征转成训练期语义约束，而不是 ImageNet 分类结果本身。可以跳过大部分下游分类表格，只保留效率对比和消融结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether semantic knowledge from a language model can improve a vision-only classifier without large-scale image-text contrastive pretraining and without adding any text component at inference time.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect. The main setting is supervised ViT training on ImageNet, not general-purpose multimodal pretraining. The useful part is the training-signal design: frozen text representations are used as semantic anchors that regularize image features during training. This gives a low-cost alternative to full image-text co-training and is relevant to questions around cross-modal representation geometry, auxiliary objectives, and how semantic priors can shape early feature formation.
summary_en.technical_approach: TextTeacher first obtains captions for ImageNet images using a pretrained captioning model, then encodes those captions with a frozen text encoder. During vision training, a lightweight projection maps visual features into the text-embedding space, and an auxiliary alignment loss pulls image features toward their corresponding textual anchors. The classifier is still trained with the standard supervised objective. At inference time, both the text encoder and the projection head are removed, so the deployed model remains a normal ViT. A key design choice is that captions should contain concise information beyond the class label; otherwise the auxiliary signal mostly duplicates the label and adds little. Compared with knowledge distillation, this method does not require a large teacher to be queried for dense predictions throughout training, and it does not convert the model into a multimodal architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on ImageNet and several fine-grained transfer benchmarks using standard ViT backbones. With the same training recipe and compute budget, TextTeacher improves ImageNet accuracy by up to 2.7 percentage points. Under noisy labels, the gain reaches 8.4 percentage points. For transformer backbones, average transfer performance improves by about 1.0 percentage point. In compute-controlled comparisons, it outperforms several distillation-style baselines, or reaches comparable or better accuracy with roughly 66% of the training time. The ablations suggest that the auxiliary text signal mainly helps in the early phase of optimization, acts more strongly in deeper layers, and behaves like a feature-space preconditioner rather than a permanent inference-time dependency.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–20 minutes. Focus on the auxiliary alignment objective, the caption-generation choices, and the ablations on training stage, layer placement, caption content, and noisy labels. For pretraining researchers, the main takeaway is the use of frozen language representations as a cheap semantic constraint during representation learning, not the ImageNet classification setup itself.

recommendation.zh: 仅看方法部分即可，跨模态知识注入的低成本思路可作为多模态预训练消融的参考，无范式级突破
recommendation.en: Only read the method section; the low-cost cross-modal knowledge injection idea can serve as reference for multimodal pretraining ablations, no paradigm-level breakthrough.

institutions: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI)

paper.title: Self-Policy Distillation via Capability-Selective Subspace Projection
paper.abstract: Self-distillation bootstraps large language models (LLMs) by training on their own generations. However, existing methods either rely on external signals to curate self-generated outputs (e.g., correctness filtering, execution feedback, and reward search), which are costly and unavailable for the best-performing frontier models, or skip curation entirely and train on all raw outputs, an approach that is often domain-specific and hard to generalize. Both also share a deeper weakness that self-gen

summary.core_problem: 在不依赖外部 verifier/奖励/执行反馈的前提下，让 self-distillation 产生可跨领域泛化的增益，并避免把自生成数据里的风格、格式、错误模式一起蒸馏进去导致信号被稀释。
summary.importance: 对 post-train/持续自训练更直接：它提供了一种“内部信号”做自生成数据的能力选择（capability-selective）方法，试图把自蒸馏从“全量模仿输出”变成“只放大目标能力相关的表示方向”。对预训练研究的启发点在于：用梯度在激活空间里抽取低秩子空间，再用投影钩子在生成阶段做 steering，是一种把“训练信号”前置到数据生成环节的思路，可能比事后过滤更便宜、更通用。
summary.technical_approach:
SPD 分两阶段：
1) 子空间提取（calibration）：用一个小校准集，定义 correctness spans（直接决定任务成败的答案 token 区间），只在这些位置计算 loss。然后对选定层的 key/value 激活求梯度，收集梯度矩阵并做 SVD，得到低秩 capability subspace（分别针对 K/V）。直觉是：这些梯度方向更“对准”目标能力，而不是格式/风格。
2) 生成期 steering + 蒸馏：在解码时对对应层的 KV 激活注册 projection hooks，把中间表示投影到上述子空间（不改参数），用 hooked 模型为每个 prompt 生成一个 completion，构造自生成语料。生成完移除 hooks，用原模型对 prompt–completion 做标准 NTP 微调。
关键取舍：不做外部筛选（省成本、适用于 frontier 模型缺少可靠外部信号的场景）；也不直接用原模型裸生成（避免把噪声/风格一起学回去）。用“梯度-低秩-投影”在生成阶段做软约束，等价于一种轻量的 test-time representation editing 来改善训练数据分布。
summary.experiments:
覆盖三类能力域：代码、数学推理、多选 QA；并在五个 backbone 上评估（文中未在给定片段列出具体模型名）。设置包含 in-domain 与 out-of-domain transfer 两种。
结果以相对提升汇报：相对无外部信号的 SOTA 自蒸馏方法最高提升 13%；相对预训练基线 in-domain 最高提升 16%；out-of-domain 最高提升 15%。
从方法结构看，关键对照应包括：不加投影钩子的裸 self-distill、不同秩 r、不同层位置/只投影 K 或 V、以及 correctness span 定义方式；这些决定“能力选择”是否真实发生，而不是简单的解码扰动带来的偶然收益（建议读实验/消融确认）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读路径：
- 先读方法 3.2/3.3：搞清楚 correctness span 怎么标、梯度对 KV 激活怎么取、SVD 得到的投影矩阵如何挂到解码图里。
- 再看主结果图（Fig.1 及对应表格）：重点看 out-of-domain 是否稳定、以及不同 backbone 是否一致。
- 最后扫消融：rank/层/只 K 或只 V/校准集大小，对判断可复现性最关键。
预计阅读时间：30–45 分钟能抓住方法与主要结论；要复现实现细节需要再加 30 分钟看附录/实现说明（如果提供）。

summary_en.core_problem: Make self-distillation work without any external signals (verifiers, rewards, execution feedback) while remaining domain-general, by preventing self-generated data from entangling the target capability with style/formatting artifacts and model-specific errors.
summary_en.importance: Most directly relevant to post-training and continual self-training: it proposes an internal, capability-selective way to shape self-generated corpora before distillation. The broader pretraining-facing idea is to use gradients to extract a low-rank “capability subspace” in activation space, then apply projection hooks during decoding to steer generations—shifting part of the supervision design from after-the-fact filtering to data generation-time control.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SPD is a two-phase pipeline:
1) Calibration / subspace extraction: define correctness spans (answer tokens that determine success) and compute a loss only on those positions. Collect gradients w.r.t. key/value activations at selected layers across a small calibration set, then run SVD to obtain low-rank projection subspaces for K and V.
2) Generation-time steering + distillation: register projection hooks on the corresponding KV activations during decoding to project intermediate representations onto the capability subspace (no parameter updates). Use the hooked model to generate one completion per training prompt, forming a self-generated corpus. Remove hooks and fine-tune the original model on the prompt–completion pairs with standard next-token loss.
Design trade-off: avoids costly/fragile external curation, but also avoids naive “train on raw self-outputs” by biasing generations toward capability-aligned directions rather than style/noise.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated across three capability domains (code, math reasoning, multiple-choice QA) and five backbones (not enumerated in the provided excerpt). Two transfer regimes are reported: in-domain and out-of-domain.
Reported gains are relative improvements: up to 13% over prior self-distillation methods without external signals, up to 16% over pretrained baselines in-domain, and up to 15% better out-of-domain.
Key validations to look for in the paper’s ablations: removing hooks (plain self-distill), varying subspace rank, layer placement, projecting only K vs only V, and calibration set size / correctness-span definitions—these determine whether the method is truly capability-selective rather than a generic decoding perturbation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Sections 3.2–3.3 to understand the mechanics (correctness spans, how KV gradients are collected, how SVD projections are implemented as decoding hooks).
- Main results (Fig. 1 and core tables): focus on out-of-domain transfer stability and consistency across backbones.
- Ablations: rank/layer/K-only vs V-only/calibration size are the most informative for reproducibility.
Time: ~30–45 minutes for the core idea and results; add ~30 minutes if you want implementation-level clarity from appendices.

recommendation.zh: 想做无 verifier 的 self-bootstrapping 可以看；关键不是结果表，而是它把“能力”近似成梯度低秩子空间，这个假设值得单独做 ablation。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about verifier-free self-bootstrapping; the real idea is treating capability as a low-rank gradient subspace, which deserves standalone ablation.

paper.title: The Matching Principle: A Geometric Theory of Loss Functions for Nuisance-Robust Representation Learning
paper.abstract: Robustness, domain adaptation, photometric and occlusion invariance, compositional generalisation, temporal robustness, alignment safety, and classical anisotropic regularisation are usually treated as separate problems with separate method families. This paper argues that much of their shared structure is one statistical problem: estimate the covariance of label-preserving deployment nuisance, then regularise the encoder Jacobian along a matrix whose range covers that covariance (the matching p

summary.core_problem: 现有鲁棒性、域适应、对齐安全等多个方向的方法各自独立发展，缺乏统一的统计框架解释其共同结构，也没有可证伪的设计准则指导损失函数设计，导致方法对比仅依赖排行榜跑分、ablation实验缺乏统一判断标准。
summary.importance: 为预训练中的表示学习正则化、域漂移鲁棒性、对齐安全性等问题提供了统一的几何分析框架，将损失函数从默认配置提升为可参数化设计的核心变量，其可证伪的检验规则也为相关方法的实验设计提供了明确指导。
summary.technical_approach: 提出匹配原则（Matching Principle），将各类标签保持型部署扰动（nuisance）的共同统计特征抽象为扰动协方差矩阵Σ_task，认为最优正则化需要让正则化矩阵Σ'的值域覆盖Σ_task的值域。在此基础上推导了扰动匹配假设（PMH）损失函数，即任务损失加编码器雅可比矩阵的迹惩罚，统一了CORAL、对抗训练、IRM、数据增强、度量学习、对齐约束等10余种现有方法。同时给出了五步法设计流程和可证伪的ablation检验规则，明确了框架的适用边界（不覆盖因果/伪相关问题）。
summary.experiments: 在视觉、语音、代码、分子、语言5种模态，从线性模型到7B参数量的Qwen2.5 Transformer共13组实验中，验证了匹配正则化的效果显著优于各向同性正则化和方向错误的正则化，符合理论预测。仅在Office-31数据集上CORAL优于匹配PMH，该结果恰好符合框架预先指出的“估计器特征间隙接近Wedin界时失效”的失败模式。在7B模型的1轮DPO对齐实验中验证了机制的有效性，不过框架明确指出该结果不替代全规模多轮RLHF。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第1章的核心思想概述、第2-3章的问题定义和ERM局限分析、第8章的大模型实验结果；理论推导部分可根据需求选择性阅读，预计阅读时间30-40分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing methods across robustness, domain adaptation, alignment safety, and other related directions have developed independently, lacking a unified statistical framework to explain their shared structure. There is also no falsifiable design principle to guide loss function design, leading to method comparisons that rely solely on leaderboard rankings and ablation experiments that lack consistent judgment criteria.
summary_en.importance: Provides a unified geometric analysis framework for representation learning regularization, domain drift robustness, alignment safety, and other problems in pretraining. It elevates loss functions from default configurations to a core parameterizable design variable, and its falsifiable test rules offer clear guidance for experimental design of related methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Matching Principle, which abstracts the common statistical feature of all label-preserving deployment nuisances as a perturbation covariance matrix Σ_task, and states that optimal regularization requires the range of the regularization matrix Σ' to cover the range of Σ_task. Based on this, the Perturbation Matching Hypothesis (PMH) loss function is derived, consisting of task loss plus a trace penalty on the encoder Jacobian. This framework unifies over 10 existing methods including CORAL, adversarial training, IRM, data augmentation, metric learning, and alignment constraints. It also provides a five-step design workflow and falsifiable ablation test rules, with explicit scope boundaries (causal/spurious correlation problems are out of scope).
summary_en.experiments: 13 sets of experiments across 5 modalities (vision, speech, code, molecules, language) and scales (from linear models to 7B-parameter Qwen2.5 Transformer) verify that matched regularization significantly outperforms isotropic regularization and wrong-direction regularization, consistent with theoretical predictions. The only case where matched PMH is outperformed by a competing method (CORAL on Office-31) exactly matches the failure mode predicted in advance by the framework: failure when the estimator's eigengap is close to the Wedin bound. The mechanism is validated in a 1-epoch DPO alignment experiment on 7B models, though the framework explicitly states this result does not replace full-scale multi-epoch RLHF.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1 for core idea overview, Sections 2-3 for problem definition and ERM limitation analysis, and Section 8 for large model experimental results. Theoretical derivation sections can be read selectively based on need. Estimated reading time: 30-40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做预训练损失设计、正则化、对齐鲁棒性的读§3的统一框架即可，实验部分可跳过
recommendation.en: For researchers working on pretrain loss, regularization or alignment robustness, read §3 for the unified framework, skip experiments.

paper.title: Winfree Oscillatory Neural Network
paper.abstract: Oscillations and synchronization are widely believed to play a fundamental role in representation and computation. However, existing machine learning approaches based on synchronization dynamics have largely been confined to specialized settings such as object discovery, with limited evidence of scalability to standard vision benchmarks or logic reasoning tasks. We propose the Winfree Oscillatory Neural Network (WONN), a dynamical neural architecture based on generalized Winfree dynamics. WONN e

summary.core_problem: 论文试图回答一个架构问题：同步振荡动力学能否从小规模、专用的 object discovery 场景扩展到标准视觉识别和组合推理任务，并成为一种参数效率较高的神经网络计算方式。
summary.importance: 这篇论文和 LLM 预训练的关系是间接的，但对架构研究有参考价值。它提供了一种不同于 Transformer、CNN、SSM 的表示演化方式：状态不是普通实值向量的静态层间映射，而是在环面相位空间上迭代同步。对基座模型研究者来说，值得看的点是它如何把连续动力系统、迭代推理和参数效率结合起来，尤其是 maze、Sudoku 这类需要多步约束传播的任务。
summary.technical_approach: WONN 基于 generalized Winfree dynamics。每个神经元被表示为相位振荡器，整体状态位于高维环面 (S1)^d 上。和 Kuramoto 模型主要依赖成对相位差不同，Winfree 形式把交互拆成 sensitivity function 和 influence function，因此可以表达更丰富的同步结构。论文提供两类交互实现：固定三角函数映射，以及可学习神经网络映射。它还引入 grouped dynamics，用分组方式支持局部协调和全局信息流。另一个设计是 phase-frequency 双状态：相位用于较快的同步更新，频率用于较慢的表征演化，从而支持稳定的迭代 refinement。对三角交互形式，作者还给出 interaction energy，用作稳定性视角和推理任务诊断信号。
summary.experiments: 实验包括 CIFAR、ImageNet-1K、Maze-hard 和 Sudoku。作者报告 WONN 在视觉任务上能达到与卷积网络、Transformer 类模型和已有同步架构相近或更好的准确率，同时参数量更低。ImageNet-1K 结果用于证明振荡同步架构可以扩展到标准大规模视觉 benchmark。推理任务上，WONN 在 Maze-hard 上用约为 HRM 1% 的参数达到有竞争力的表现；在 Sudoku 上达到满分测试准确率。论文还观察到 learned representation 中出现双峰相位组织，不同同步相位组分别偏向粗粒度和细粒度图像结构。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 分钟。优先看 Section 2 的动力学定义，特别是 Winfree 与 Kuramoto 的差异、sensitivity / influence 分解、grouped dynamics 和 phase-frequency 双状态。视觉实验可快速看参数量与准确率表，不必细抠每个 baseline。推理实验更值得停留，尤其是 Maze-hard、Sudoku 和 interaction energy 的诊断图。若从 LLM 架构角度阅读，重点不是它的视觉结果，而是迭代相位同步是否能作为一种轻量的约束传播模块。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether synchronization-based oscillatory dynamics can move beyond small, specialized object-discovery settings and scale to standard vision benchmarks and combinatorial reasoning tasks.
summary_en.importance: The connection to LLM pretraining is indirect, but the architectural signal is useful. WONN represents a different computation pattern from Transformers, CNNs, and SSMs: representations evolve through iterative synchronization on a toroidal phase space rather than through a purely feed-forward stack of real-valued transformations. For foundation-model researchers, the interesting part is the link between continuous dynamics, iterative refinement, and parameter efficiency, especially on tasks that require constraint propagation such as mazes and Sudoku.
summary_en.technical_approach: WONN is built on generalized Winfree dynamics. Each neuron is a phase oscillator, and the full representation lies on a high-dimensional torus, (S1)^d. Unlike Kuramoto-style systems, which mainly depend on pairwise phase differences, Winfree dynamics separate interactions into sensitivity and influence functions. This gives the model more flexible synchronization behavior. The interaction functions can be fixed trigonometric maps or learnable neural networks. The architecture also uses grouped dynamics to combine local coordination with global information flow. A phase-frequency state design separates fast phase synchronization from slower frequency evolution, which supports stable iterative refinement. For trigonometric interactions, the model admits an interaction energy that can be used as a stability diagnostic, especially in reasoning tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover CIFAR, ImageNet-1K, Maze-hard, and Sudoku. The paper reports that WONN matches or exceeds convolutional, Transformer-like, and prior synchronization-inspired baselines while using fewer parameters. The ImageNet-1K result is used to show that oscillatory synchronization can scale to a standard large vision benchmark. On reasoning tasks, WONN reaches competitive Maze-hard performance with about 1% of the parameters of HRM, and achieves perfect test accuracy on Sudoku. The representation analysis reports bimodal phase organization, with different synchronized phase groups specializing in coarse and fine image structure.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 30 minutes. Start with the dynamics in Section 2: the difference between Winfree and Kuramoto dynamics, the sensitivity/influence decomposition, grouped dynamics, and the phase-frequency state. For the vision results, read the accuracy-versus-parameter tables rather than every baseline detail. Spend more time on the reasoning experiments, especially Maze-hard, Sudoku, and the interaction-energy diagnostics. From an LLM-architecture perspective, the useful question is whether iterative phase synchronization can serve as a lightweight constraint-propagation module, not whether the model is a direct replacement for Transformer pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 振荡神经网络架构的系统性探索，相位编码和环面表示的思路对思考非Transformer建模范式有启发性，重点看§3的动力学设计。
recommendation.en: Systematic exploration of oscillatory neural network architectures; phase encoding and torus representation ideas are provocative for non-Transformer paradigm thinking; focus on §3 dynamics design.

paper.title: Multimodal LLMs under Pairwise Modalities
paper.abstract: Despite the impressive results achieved by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), their training typically relies on jointly curated multimodal data, requiring substantial human effort to construct multi-way aligned datasets and thereby limiting scalability across domains. In this work, we explore training MLLMs by only leveraging multiple paired modalities as a surrogate for the full joint multimodal distribution. Specifically, we first provide a theoretical analysis of the conditions under

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型扩展到新模态时，通常需要同一样本上同时对齐文本、图像、音频、视频、3D、触觉等多路数据。这样的全联合数据很难规模化获得。该工作研究一个更实际的问题：只观察若干成对模态数据，例如图文、3D-文本、触觉-图像，能否恢复可组合的共享表示，并把新模态接入已有 LLM / MLLM。
summary.importance: 这是一篇值得精读的多模态预训练论文。贡献不在于提出一个更大的模型，而在于把“多模态扩展”从全联合监督改成 pairwise supervision，并给出可识别性分析和可落地训练框架。对基座研究的影响主要有三点：第一，降低新模态接入对全量多路对齐数据的依赖；第二，区分 shared latent 和 private latent，避免把模态私有信息强行对齐；第三，通过 representation recomposition 复用冻结的预训练 LLM / MLLM，减少为新模态反复全模型微调带来的遗忘和训练成本。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两层。理论部分构造一个多模态生成模型：每个模态观测由共享潜变量和模态私有潜变量生成，训练数据只覆盖模态图上的若干边。核心结论是，只要 pairwise modality graph 具有足够连通性，并且成对数据覆盖了共享因子的重叠关系，在常见可识别性假设下，共享表示可以从成对观测中恢复，而不必看到完整多路联合样本。方法部分对应设计了两阶段框架。第一阶段学习统一 latent space：用 self-modal reconstruction 保留单模态语义和稳定训练，用 cross-modal contrastive alignment 把成对样本的共享 latent 拉近。同时加入两个结构约束：partial representation alignment 只对齐应当共享的子空间，避免私有因素被误对齐；minimal latent specification 抑制共享表示携带不必要的模态私有信息。第二阶段做 representation recomposition：把新模态 encoder 对齐到已有文本或图像 latent，再与冻结的 LLM / MLLM 解码能力重组。例如 3D 点云先通过 3D-文本对齐到文本 latent，再接入文本 decoder 生成语言输出。与 adapter、LoRA 或指令微调不同，这一路线尽量不改动已有预训练模型参数。
summary.experiments: 实验以 Qwen3-Omni 作为已有 MLLM，该模型已经覆盖图像、文本、视频和音频；工作尝试接入 3D 点云和触觉两个新模态。数据来自 Objaverse 和 TVL，使用的监督边包括 text-3D、text-tactile 和 image-tactile。对比对象包括已有多模态模型和 adapter 式接入基线。结果显示，只用有限 pairwise 数据也能获得有效跨模态迁移。关键消融围绕三点展开：仅做对比对齐不够稳定，重建项有助于保留单模态信息；全空间强制对齐会混入私有因素，partial alignment 更合理；minimal specification 能减少共享 latent 的过度编码。由于预训练 MLLM 保持冻结，方法也更容易保留原模型已有能力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Theory，确认可识别性结论依赖哪些假设，尤其是 modality graph 连通性、共享/私有 latent 的划分、以及成对边如何传递共享因子。再看 Method 中两个结构约束：partial representation alignment 和 minimal latent specification，这是区别于普通 CLIP 式成对对齐的关键。实验部分重点看 3D 和 tactile 接入结果、adapter 基线比较、以及去掉 reconstruction / partial alignment / minimal specification 的消融。若关心 native multimodal pretraining，可以进一步思考它和 Chameleon、Emu3、Qwen-Omni 这类全模态混合训练路线的取舍：前者数据需求低、易扩模态；后者端到端联合建模更强，但数据和训练代价更高。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to train and extend multimodal LLMs when full multi-way aligned data is unavailable. Instead of assuming that every example contains text, image, audio, video, 3D, tactile signals, and other modalities at once, it asks whether pairwise datasets such as image-text, 3D-text, or tactile-image are sufficient to recover a shared representation space and connect new modalities to an existing LLM or MLLM.
summary_en.importance: This is a must-read for multimodal pretraining. The contribution is not a larger model or another adapter recipe. The important part is the formulation: scalable modality expansion from pairwise supervision, supported by an identifiability argument and a practical recomposition mechanism. For foundation-model training, the paper is useful because it separates shared latent factors from modality-private factors, reduces reliance on expensive fully aligned corpora, and provides a way to reuse frozen pretrained LLM / MLLM components when adding scarce modalities.
summary_en.technical_approach: The theory models each modality as an observation generated from shared and private latent variables. Training data only gives edges in a modality graph, not full joint samples. Under connectivity and identifiability assumptions, shared factors can be recovered from overlapping pairwise observations. The implementation follows this structure in two stages. First, it learns a unified latent space using self-modal reconstruction and cross-modal contrastive alignment. Reconstruction preserves modality-specific semantics and stabilizes training; contrastive alignment ties paired samples together in the shared space. The framework then adds two structural biases: partial representation alignment, which aligns only the shared subspace, and minimal latent specification, which discourages the shared representation from carrying unnecessary private information. Second, it performs representation recomposition. A new modality encoder is aligned to an existing textual or visual latent space, then combined with a frozen pretrained decoder or MLLM interface. For example, a 3D encoder aligned through 3D-text pairs can be recomposed with a text decoder to produce text conditioned on point clouds. This differs from instruction-tuned adapters or LoRA-style updates because the pretrained model is largely kept unchanged.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3-Omni as the existing multimodal backbone, which already covers image, text, video, and audio. The paper adds two new modalities, 3D point clouds and tactile sensing, using Objaverse and TVL. The available supervision consists of text-3D, text-tactile, and image-tactile pairs. Comparisons include existing multimodal models and adapter-based baselines. The reported results show that pairwise supervision can support effective cross-modal transfer under limited data. The ablations are the most informative part: reconstruction improves stability and preserves single-modality information; naive full-space alignment is less appropriate because it mixes private factors into the shared space; partial alignment and minimal specification give cleaner shared representations. Keeping the pretrained backbone frozen also helps preserve existing capabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it carefully. Start with the theory section and check the exact assumptions behind identifiability: modality-graph connectivity, shared/private latent decomposition, and how pairwise edges propagate common factors. Then focus on the method sections for partial representation alignment and minimal latent specification, since these are the main differences from standard CLIP-style pairwise alignment. In the experiments, prioritize the 3D and tactile integration results, the adapter comparisons, and the ablations removing reconstruction, partial alignment, or minimal specification. For native multimodal pretraining, the useful comparison is with fully joint training systems such as Chameleon, Emu3, or Qwen-Omni: pairwise recomposition is cheaper and easier to extend, while full joint training may offer stronger end-to-end coupling when the data exists.

recommendation.zh: 应读理论条件和 ablation；若假设站得住，它会改变多模态预训练的数据采购优先级，从三元组转向可组合 pairwise corpus。
recommendation.en: Read the theory conditions and ablations; if the assumptions hold, it shifts multimodal data strategy from multi-way tuples toward composable pairwise corpora.

paper.title: Why Latent Actions Fail, and How to Prevent It
paper.abstract: Latent action models (LAMs) aim to learn action-like representations from unlabeled videos by compressing frame-to-frame changes. The frames of in-the-wild videos, however, contain not only the agent's own state but exogenous state such as background clutter. Since the exogenous state introduces changes unrelated to actions, it hinders reliable latent action learning. This paper investigates this problem analytically by extending a linear LAM framework to explicitly model exogenous state. Our an

summary.core_problem: 研究无标注视频中的 latent action model 为何会学到与动作无关的外生变化，而不是稳定的动作表征。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制分析工作，不是 LLM 论文，但它讨论了表示学习目标在存在外生噪声时会学偏到未来观测信息的问题；这个结论对 world model、视频 token 建模和 action abstraction 有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在线性化的 LAM 框架中显式引入 exogenous state，分析标准重建目标的最优解会如何把未来观测中的外生信息压进 latent action。进一步提出应在更聚焦 endogenous component 的表示空间中学习，并证明已有一些辅助目标，如 action supervision，会促进跨外生状态的一致动作表示。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示作者用分析推导加实验验证两点结论：标准 reconstruction objective 会污染 latent action；聚焦 endogenous representation 或加入辅助监督能缓解该问题。由于给出的摘要不完整，具体数据集、模型规模和提升幅度无法确认。
summary.authors_note: 首尔大学与 Microsoft Research 合作。微软研究院背景让这篇工作在 world model / representation learning 方向上比普通应用论文更值得扫一眼。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why latent action models trained on unlabeled videos often encode exogenous changes instead of stable action-like factors.
summary_en.importance: This is not an LLM paper, but it offers a useful analysis of how representation-learning objectives fail under exogenous noise. That can still inform work on world models, video tokenization, and action abstraction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors extend a linear LAM framework with an explicit exogenous-state variable and show analytically that the standard reconstruction objective encourages latent actions to absorb future exogenous information. They then argue for learning in a representation space focused on endogenous components, and prove that auxiliary objectives such as action supervision promote consistency across exogenous states.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the paper combines theory with empirical validation of two claims: standard reconstruction contaminates latent actions with exogenous information, while endogenous-focused representations or auxiliary supervision mitigate the issue. The provided abstract is truncated, so datasets, model sizes, and exact gains cannot be verified.
summary_en.authors_note: A collaboration between Seoul National University and Microsoft Research. The Microsoft angle makes it more worth skimming than a typical application paper in representation learning.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但如果你做 world model 或视频 token abstraction，可只看理论部分：它把“重建目标为何学偏”讲得很干净，正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but if you work on world models or video token abstraction, read the theory only—it cleanly explains how reconstruction objectives drift toward the wrong factors.

paper.title: The Unlearnability Phenomenon in RLVR for Language Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has proven effective in improving Large Language Model's (LLM) reasoning ability. However, the learning dynamics of RLVR remain underexplored. In this paper, we reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon: among hard examples that the model initially struggles with, a substantial subset remains unlearnable even when correct rollouts are present. To understand the phenomenon, we first demonstrate that existing optimization and sampling techniques fail

summary.core_problem: 解释 RLVR 训练中的一个反常现象：即使某些难例已经出现正确 rollout，模型仍长期学不会，为什么会这样。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 pretrain/post-train 接口很有价值。它不是提出更强 RLVR 算法，而是指出 RLVR 的失败有一部分不是 credit assignment 或采样不够，而是表征层面的“不可学性”。贡献类型是训练动态与机制分析，直接影响如何理解 RL 对推理能力的边界。
summary.technical_approach: 作者系统研究 RLVR 中的 unlearnability。先验证常见优化和采样技巧无法消除这类难例；再做 cross-example gradient analysis，发现不可学样本与其他样本的梯度相似度低，说明它们依赖的表征方向与主流训练分布脱节，推理模式也更难泛化。进一步分析表明，在 RL 阶段做数据增强也难以改善这种梯度相容性，因此问题更像是底层表示缺口，而不是 rollout 不够或 reward 稀疏。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和任务集，但实验结构很清楚：比较可学/不可学 hard examples，测试现有 optimization 与 sampling 技术是否能救回；再用跨样本梯度相似度和泛化行为刻画 representation flaw。核心结果是：存在一批 hard examples，即便有正确轨迹也持续学不会；且 RL 过程难以修复其表示缺陷。没有看到完整数值前，最值得关注的是分析方法和 failure mode 定义。
summary.authors_note: He He 是较知名的 NLP/LLM 研究者，长期关注语言建模、推理与学习动态。其余作者背景在给定信息中无法进一步确认。

summary_en.core_problem: It explains a counterintuitive failure mode in RLVR: why some hard examples remain unlearnable even when correct rollouts are already present in training.
summary_en.importance: This is highly relevant to the pretrain/post-train interface. Rather than proposing yet another stronger RLVR recipe, it argues that part of RLVR failure is not about credit assignment or insufficient sampling, but about representation-level unlearnability. The contribution is a training-dynamics and mechanism analysis that sharpens the boundary of what RL can realistically fix.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper systematically studies unlearnability in RLVR. It first shows that existing optimization and sampling tricks do not resolve the issue. It then uses cross-example gradient analysis and finds that unlearnable examples have low gradient similarity with the rest of the data, suggesting that they rely on representation directions poorly aligned with the dominant training distribution and on reasoning patterns that do not generalize. It further shows that data augmentation in RL does not improve this gradient compatibility, pointing to a representation deficit rather than a mere rollout or reward problem.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or exact task suites, but the experimental logic is clear: compare learnable vs. unlearnable hard examples, test whether standard optimization/sampling methods can recover them, and characterize them via gradient similarity and generalization behavior. The main result is that a substantial subset of hard examples remains unlearnable despite correct rollouts, and RL struggles to repair the underlying representation flaw. The analysis setup matters more than the headline numbers here.
summary_en.authors_note: He He is a well-known NLP/LLM researcher with sustained work on language modeling, reasoning, and learning dynamics. The provided metadata does not allow a more precise note for the other authors.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你怎么看 RL 能否补 pretrain 的洞；建议优先看梯度相似度分析和“正确 rollout 仍学不会”的定义，值得在内部 RLVR 日志上复现。
recommendation.en: This changes how you think about RL as a patch for pretraining gaps; start with the gradient-similarity analysis and the definition of 'correct rollout yet still unlearnable,' then try to reproduce it on your own RLVR logs.

paper.title: Optimal Representation Size: High-Dimensional Analysis of Pretraining and Linear Probing
paper.abstract: Learning to generalise from limited data is a fundamental challenge for both artificial and biological systems. A common strategy is to extract reusable structure from abundant unlabelled data, enabling efficient adaptation to new tasks from limited labelled data. This two-stage paradigm is now standard in modern training pipelines, where pretraining is followed by fine-tuning or linear probing. We provide an analytical model of this process: structure extraction is formalized as principal compo

summary.core_problem: 两阶段学习（无监督预训练+下游线性探测/微调）场景下，表示维度（隐藏层大小）如何与预训练数据量、下游标注数据量、任务结构共同作用影响泛化性能，目前缺少高维场景下的定量解析框架。
summary.importance: 为隐藏层维度选择、预训练数据与标注数据的性价比权衡提供了理论参考，可指导算力在增维、加无监督数据、加标注数据三者之间的最优分配，适配当前预训练阶段大规模缩放维度与数据的实践需求。
summary.technical_approach: 将无监督预训练形式化为尖峰协方差模型下的PCA特征提取，下游任务简化为线性回归。在高维渐近假设下推导训练误差、估计误差、泛化误差的精确解析表达式，进一步识别不同参数区域下的最优表示维度，以及无监督数据价值超过标注数据的相变点。最后通过自编码器训练、预训练Transformer线性探测实验验证理论结论。
summary.experiments: 理想PCA+线性回归设置下，误差表达式的准确性得到验证。识别出两个相变区域：任务信号集中在少数主成分时，低维压缩表示泛化更优；任务信号分散在大量成分时，高维表示更优。当无监督数据量远大于标注数据量时，增加无监督数据的收益高于增加同量级标注数据。自编码器与预训练Transformer的线性探测实验中，表示维度与泛化误差的关联趋势与理论预测一致。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第1章的问题定义与贡献总结、第3章的核心定理结论，以及图2（无监督/标注数据价值对比）、图3（维度选择的相变区域）、图4（真实模型验证结果），跳过复杂的数学证明部分，预计阅读时间30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: There lacks a quantitative analytical framework in the high-dimensional regime to characterize how representation dimensionality interacts with pretraining data volume, downstream labeled data volume, and task structure to shape generalization performance in the standard two-stage learning paradigm of unsupervised pretraining followed by downstream linear probing or fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: It provides theoretical references for hidden layer dimension selection and cost-performance tradeoff between pretraining data and labeled data. It can guide optimal compute allocation across scaling model dimension, adding unsupervised data, and adding labeled data, which aligns with current pretraining practice that heavily scales both dimension and data size.
summary_en.technical_approach: It formalizes unsupervised pretraining as PCA feature extraction under a spiked covariance model, and downstream learning as linear regression. Under high-dimensional asymptotic assumptions, it derives exact analytical expressions for training error, estimation error, and generalization error. It further identifies the optimal representation size across different parameter regimes, and the phase transition point where unsupervised data becomes more valuable than labeled data. Theoretical conclusions are validated via autoencoder training and linear probing experiments on pretrained transformers.
summary_en.experiments: The accuracy of derived error expressions is first verified in the ideal PCA + linear regression setting. Two phase transition regimes are identified: low-dimensional compressed representations achieve better generalization when task signal concentrates on a few principal components, while high-dimensional representations perform better when task signal is dispersed across a large number of components. When unsupervised data volume is much larger than labeled data, adding unsupervised data yields higher gains than adding the same amount of labeled data. Linear probing experiments on autoencoders and pretrained transformers produce generalization error vs. dimension curves consistent with theoretical predictions.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Section 1 for problem definition and contribution summary, core theorem conclusions in Section 3, Figure 2 (value comparison between unsupervised and labeled data), Figure 3 (phase transition regimes for dimension selection), and Figure 4 (validation on real models). Skip complex mathematical proofs. Estimated reading time: 30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把“表示维度”当一等公民做可解析推导，适合校准你对线性探针与表征瓶颈的直觉；重点看最优维度随label/unlabel比变化的相图。
recommendation.en: A clean analytic treatment that makes representation size a first-class knob; skim for the phase diagram of optimal dimension vs labeled/unlabeled data and task alignment.

institutions: Institute of Science and Technology Austria

paper.title: Where Does Authorship Signal Emerge in Encoder-Based Language Models?
paper.abstract: Authorship attribution models fine-tuned with the same pretrained encoder, data, and loss can differ four-fold in performance depending only on their scoring mechanism. We use mechanistic interpretability tools to explain this gap. Stylistic features such as word length, punctuation density, and function-word frequency are equally available at every layer in every model, including in an off-the-shelf control encoder, hence the gap not coming from representation quality. Instead, causal intervent

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个很具体但很有代表性的问题：在同一个预训练 encoder、同一份数据、同一种对比学习损失下，为什么仅仅更换 scoring / pooling 机制，就会让 authorship attribution 的性能出现约四倍差距。作者要区分两种解释：一种是不同 scorer 让 encoder 学到了不同质量的内部表示；另一种是底层风格特征其实各层都有，差距主要来自 scorer 如何迫使这些特征在网络中被整合、并在何处变成对最终决策因果必要的信号。论文的结论偏向后者：特征可读性并不是瓶颈，真正决定性能的是 scorer 改变了梯度结构和训练动态，从而改变 authorship signal 在 encoder 中出现和巩固的层位。
summary.importance: 这不是基座预训练论文，但对做预训练和表征学习的人有明确启发。它提醒人不要把“下游性能差异”直接归因于 backbone 表征质量。很多时候，预训练模型早已编码了足够多的低层统计与风格特征，真正的差别来自 readout 头如何组织梯度、如何决定哪些层必须承担信息压缩与整合。这个观察对 pooling 设计、contrastive fine-tuning、retrieval scorer、甚至多模态对齐头都有参考价值。更重要的是，论文把 feature availability 和 feature use 分开讨论，这个框架对分析预训练表示是否“学到了某种能力”很有用：能线性读出，不等于模型在当前目标下会因果性地使用它。
summary.technical_approach:
作者研究的是 Kulumba 等人训练的一组对比式 authorship attribution 模型。它们共享同一个预训练 encoder、同样的数据和 InfoNCE 训练目标，差别只在 scoring 机制：

1. Mean pooling：先把 passage 的 token 表示取平均，再做 cosine similarity。它要求 encoder 在单个向量里压缩整段文本的信息。
2. Late interaction, LI：保留 token-level 表示，用 MaxSim 之类的 token-to-token 匹配来打分。它不要求所有信息都提前压进一个全局向量。
3. Patch pooling：介于两者之间，把相邻 token 组成 patch 后先局部平均，再做 late interaction。

分析工具主要有三类。

第一类是线性 probe，用来测“风格特征是否存在于各层表示中”。作者探测的特征包括词长、标点密度、功能词频率、大小写等。结果显示，这些特征在所有模型、几乎所有层、甚至一个未针对该任务微调的 control encoder 中都能被线性读出。也就是说，fine-tuning 并没有创造这些特征。

第二类是 causal intervention，具体是 residual stream patching。做法是：给定 anchor、positive、negative 三元组，用 clean positive 和 corrupt negative 分别前向；然后在某一层把 negative 的隐藏状态替换成 positive 的对应状态，再看最终 same-author 评分恢复多少。这个实验测的是“某层表示对正确作者判断的因果贡献”。结果表明，mean pooling 模型在较早到中间层就已经把 authorship signal 整合到足以影响最终判断；LI 模型则把这种整合推迟到更后层，因为它可以依赖 token-level 匹配，不必过早压缩。

第三类是从梯度结构解释上述差异。mean pooling 的梯度会把所有 token 通过平均操作耦合起来，迫使中早层就形成可全局汇聚的作者风格表示；LI 的梯度更局部，允许不同 token 保留细粒度风格线索，到后层或 scorer 端再完成利用。patch pooling 则处在中间，形成一个连续谱，而不是二元对立。

论文还结合 alignment–uniformity 分析训练动态。作者观察到，不同 scorer 不只是最终 readout 不同，而是沿着不同的优化路径塑造 encoder：mean pooling 更早追求全局对齐，LI 则允许表示空间在更长阶段内保留局部结构。这解释了为什么两者即便共享 backbone，最终有效深度和可利用信息也不同。
summary.experiments:
从摘要和正文片段可确认的关键结果有几类。

1. 性能差距：在同样 backbone、数据和损失下，仅 scorer 不同就能带来约四倍性能差距。这是整篇论文的起点。

2. Feature availability：线性 probe 显示，词长、标点、功能词频率等风格特征在所有层都可读，而且在 off-the-shelf control encoder 中也存在。这说明性能差距不能简单解释为“某个 scorer 学到了更好的风格表示”。

3. Causal layer localization：residual stream patching 显示，mean pooling 模型的 authorship signal 在早层到中层就已变成因果必要；LI 模型则把关键贡献推迟到更晚层。这个结果比 probe 更重要，因为它区分了“可读出”与“被使用”。

4. Patch pooling 作为中间态：bigram patch（n=2）在行为上位于 mean pooling 和 LI 之间，支持作者关于“梯度结构决定整合层位”的解释，而不是偶然的架构差异。

5. 训练动态：alignment / uniformity 分析表明，不同 scorer 在 fine-tuning 过程中走出不同轨迹。虽然正文片段没有给出具体数值，但作者明确强调，差异体现在何时开始压缩作者信号、以及表示空间何时失去局部细节。

这篇论文的实验价值主要在机制证据链完整：probe 证明特征一直都在，patching 证明何处被因果使用，梯度分析解释为什么会这样，训练动态说明这种差异是如何形成的。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合做机制分析类泛读，重点不在任务本身，而在分析框架。

先看 Introduction，抓住作者要区分的两个命题：representation quality 差异，还是 readout-induced consolidation 差异。这个问题在很多 encoder fine-tuning 场景都成立。

然后看 Background 里三种 scorer 的定义，尤其是 mean pooling、late interaction、patch pooling 的数学形式。要想清楚它们对梯度传播路径的约束分别是什么。

正文里最值得看的部分是三块：
1. 线性 probe 结果：确认 feature availability 基本不变。
2. Residual stream patching：这是整篇最关键的因果证据，建议仔细看图和实验设置。
3. 梯度结构与训练动态分析：这里解释“为什么 signal emergence 的层位会不同”，也是最能迁移到别的任务的部分。

如果时间有限，30 分钟左右可以读完核心逻辑。若要深挖，建议思考两个延伸问题：第一，这种 scorer-induced depth shift 是否也会出现在 retrieval、reranker、VLM 对齐头中；第二，预训练阶段若显式鼓励某种 pooling 友好的结构，是否会改变 fine-tuning 时的最优 scorer 选择。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise but broadly relevant question: why can authorship-attribution models, trained with the same pretrained encoder, the same data, and the same contrastive loss, differ by roughly 4x in performance solely because of the scoring mechanism? The authors separate two hypotheses. One is that different scorers induce different internal representations in the encoder. The other is that stylistic features are already present throughout the network, and the real difference is where the scorer forces those features to be consolidated into causally necessary authorship signal. The paper supports the second view: feature availability is not the bottleneck; the scorer changes gradient structure and training dynamics, which in turn changes where authorship signal emerges and becomes necessary.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is useful for anyone working on representation learning, contrastive fine-tuning, or readout design. The main lesson is that downstream performance gaps should not be attributed too quickly to backbone representation quality. A pretrained encoder may already encode the relevant low-level statistics and style cues; the decisive factor can instead be how the scoring head organizes gradients and where it forces information compression. That insight matters beyond authorship attribution: it is relevant to pooling design, retrieval scoring, rerankers, and multimodal alignment heads. The paper is especially valuable for its distinction between feature availability and feature use. Linear decodability does not imply causal use under a given objective.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The study analyzes a family of contrastive authorship-attribution models from prior work. They share the same pretrained encoder, the same training data, and the same InfoNCE objective. The only difference is the scoring mechanism:

1. Mean pooling: token representations are averaged into a single passage vector, then compared with cosine similarity. This forces the encoder to compress passage-level information into one vector.
2. Late interaction (LI): token-level representations are preserved and compared with a MaxSim-style token-to-token scorer. This avoids early global compression.
3. Patch pooling: an intermediate design where contiguous token patches are mean-pooled first, then scored with late interaction.

The analysis uses three main tools.

First, linear probes test whether stylistic features are present in hidden states across layers. The probed features include word length, punctuation density, function-word frequency, capitalization, and related style cues. The result is that these features are linearly recoverable from nearly all layers in all models, including an off-the-shelf control encoder. Fine-tuning does not create them.

Second, the paper uses causal intervention via residual stream patching. Given an anchor, a same-author positive, and a different-author negative, the model runs a clean forward pass on the positive and a corrupt pass on the negative. At a chosen layer, the negative hidden state is replaced with the positive hidden state, and the final score recovery is measured. This identifies where in the encoder the relevant authorship signal becomes causally important. Mean-pooling models consolidate that signal by early-to-mid layers, whereas LI models defer consolidation to later layers because token-level matching remains available downstream.

Third, the paper explains the difference through gradient structure. Mean pooling couples all token representations through the averaging operation, so the encoder is pressured to form globally aggregatable authorship features relatively early. LI produces more local gradients and allows fine-grained stylistic cues to remain distributed across tokens until later layers or the scorer itself. Patch pooling behaves as an intermediate case, which supports the gradient-based explanation.

The paper also studies training dynamics through alignment and uniformity. The claim is that different scorers do not merely read out the same encoder differently at the end; they drive the encoder along different optimization trajectories. Mean pooling pushes earlier global alignment, while LI preserves local structure for longer.
summary_en.experiments:
The key empirical findings, based on the provided full-text excerpt, are as follows.

1. Performance gap: with the same backbone, data, and loss, changing only the scorer can produce an approximately four-fold difference in authorship-attribution performance. This is the motivating puzzle.

2. Feature availability: linear probes show that stylistic features such as word length, punctuation, and function-word usage are readable from all models at nearly all layers, and even from an off-the-shelf control encoder. So the gap cannot be explained simply by one scorer learning better style representations.

3. Causal localization across layers: residual stream patching shows that in mean-pooling models, authorship signal becomes causally necessary by early or middle layers, whereas in LI models the critical contribution is shifted later. This is more informative than probing because it distinguishes readable information from actually used information.

4. Patch pooling as an intermediate case: bigram patch pooling (n=2) behaves between mean pooling and LI, which strengthens the claim that the effect is driven by scorer-induced gradient structure rather than an arbitrary architectural quirk.

5. Training dynamics: alignment/uniformity analysis indicates that the scorers induce different optimization trajectories during fine-tuning. The excerpt does not expose all numerical details, but the paper’s argument is that the main difference lies in when the model starts compressing authorship signal and when the representation space loses local detail.

The experimental strength of the paper is the coherence of the evidence chain: probes show the features are already there, patching shows where they become causally used, gradient analysis explains why, and training dynamics shows how the divergence develops.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a good skim for researchers interested in mechanisms rather than the task itself.

Start with the introduction and keep the two competing hypotheses in mind: is the gap due to different representation quality, or due to scorer-induced consolidation of already available features? That framing generalizes well beyond authorship attribution.

Then read the background section carefully, especially the mathematical definitions of mean pooling, late interaction, and patch pooling. The important question is how each scorer constrains gradient flow and information compression.

The most valuable parts of the paper are three sections:
1. The linear-probe results, which establish that feature availability is largely invariant.
2. The residual-stream patching analysis, which is the central causal evidence.
3. The gradient-structure and training-dynamics discussion, which explains why signal emergence shifts across layers and is the most transferable part of the paper.

If time is limited, about 30 minutes is enough to extract the main mechanism. If you want to go deeper, two follow-up questions are worth thinking about: whether scorer-induced depth shifts also appear in retrieval, reranking, or VLM alignment heads; and whether pretraining objectives that favor pooling-friendly structure would change the best scorer choice during fine-tuning.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不在 LLM 主航道，但 setup 很干净：它提醒你别把“表征里有信息”误当成“优化能把信息用出来”；看梯度结构分析那部分就够。
recommendation.en: Not core LLM work, but the setup is clean: it is a good reminder that ‘information exists in the representation’ does not mean optimization can use it; read the gradient-structure analysis.

paper.title: Representation Without Reward: A JEPA Audit for LLM Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) propose that a model should learn more useful abstractions when trained to predict latent representations rather than observed outputs. For autoregressive language-model fine-tuning the principle entails a stricter requirement: the induced hidden-state geometry must reach the language-model head \emph{and} improve the decoded task metric. We test that requirement under a fixed Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct LoRA harness on natural-language-to-regex generat

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：JEPA 风格的表示学习辅助目标，在 LLM 微调里到底能不能穿过 LM head，转化成可见的解码收益，而不只是改变 hidden state 几何。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接推进，但对“表示学习目标能否作为 AR 语言模型训练补充信号”这个问题给了一个很干净的负结果。它的启发在于：hidden geometry 被改写，不等于 token-level 任务指标会改善。对考虑在 mid-train、SFT 或小样本适配阶段加入 latent/JEPA 类辅助损失的人，这篇文章提供了一个必要的约束视角：辅助目标必须与 decoder 和主损失梯度方向耦合，否则很容易只做了表示层面的‘无奖励工作’。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上是一个受控审计，而不是提出单一新算法。作者固定 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct + LoRA 微调框架、数据格式、拼接位置、解码器和 exact-match 评测，只改变辅助目标，系统比较 22 种训练期辅助项和 1 个推理期 projector。覆盖的类别包括：轨迹形状正则，如 STP 及其变体；对比式和预测式目标；分布约束；JEPA 常见的 predictor/EMA target/stop-gradient 非对称设计；Fisher-metric Jacobi residual；以及一个特意构造成落在 cross-entropy 正锥中的 decoder-visible JEPA 目标。论文的关键设计不是“多试几个 loss”，而是把问题拆成两个可检验假设：H1，辅助损失是否真的改变表示；H2，这种改变是否能改善最终解码。这个拆分让负结果更有解释力。
summary.experiments: 实验在 natural-language-to-regex 生成上进行，模型是 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 的 LoRA 微调。结果是一个结构化 null。未做多重检验校正时，少数单元格有边际提升，例如 prompt-local JFR 在 TURK 上约 +2.53 个百分点、T5 在 TURK 上约 +1.53 个百分点，SYNTH 上若干分布约束项也有 p 值在 0.06 到 0.10 之间的改善；但经过 Bonferroni 或 Holm-Bonferroni 校正后，没有一个结果站得住。BYOL-LLM 这类最直接的 JEPA 非对称测试，在两个 benchmark 上都落在 seed noise 内。Fisher-metric 替代项能消除部分几何特征，但没有带来 exact match 提升。decoder-visible JEPA 首次实现了辅助梯度与 cross-entropy 梯度的正余弦，但无论 LoRA 还是 n=5 的 full fine-tuning 复现实验，收益都没有统计上坐实。更重要的是，作者证明 H1 经常成立：不少辅助项确实改变了轨迹曲率、各向异性、seed 方差或梯度方向；只是 H2 不成立。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和实验设计图，理解作者为什么把问题拆成 H1/H2。然后直接看主结果表和统计检验部分，确认“有表示变化但无稳定任务收益”这个结论是怎么得出的。若只花 20 到 30 分钟，重点看 BYOL-LLM、Fisher-metric、decoder-visible JEPA 三组实验，它们分别对应 JEPA 非对称性、几何度量修正、梯度对齐这三个最可能解释。若想判断这项工作对自己是否有用，再补看 hidden-state geometry 指标和梯度余弦分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharp question: can JEPA-style representation objectives in LLM fine-tuning produce gains that survive the LM head and decoding rule, rather than merely reshaping hidden-state geometry?
summary_en.importance: It is not a direct pretraining advance, but it is useful for anyone considering latent or representation-level auxiliary losses for AR language models. The main lesson is that representation activity is not the same as decoder-coupled payoff. Hidden states can become smoother, less anisotropic, or more stable across seeds without yielding better token-level outputs. That is a relevant caution for mid-training, SFT, or low-data adaptation setups that try to import JEPA-like ideas from vision.
summary_en.technical_approach: This is a controlled audit rather than a single new method. The authors fix a Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct LoRA fine-tuning harness, data format, splice point, decoder, and exact-match evaluator, and vary only the auxiliary objective. They test 22 training-time auxiliaries plus one inference-time projector. The set includes trajectory-shape regularizers such as STP variants, contrastive and predictive losses, distributional constraints, JEPA-style predictor/EMA-target/stop-gradient asymmetry, Fisher-metric Jacobi residuals, and a decoder-visible JEPA objective explicitly constructed to lie in the positive cone of cross-entropy. The key framing is the split between two hypotheses: H1, the auxiliary changes representation geometry; H2, that change improves decoded task accuracy. This separation makes the negative result much more informative.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on natural-language-to-regex generation with LoRA fine-tuning of Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct. The outcome is a structured null. Before multiple-testing correction, a few cells show marginal gains, including prompt-local JFR on TURK at about +2.53 percentage points and T5 on TURK at about +1.53 points, with several distributional cells on SYNTH also appearing mildly positive. After Bonferroni or Holm-Bonferroni correction, none remains significant. BYOL-LLM, the most direct JEPA-style asymmetry test, stays within seed noise on both benchmarks. Fisher-metric variants remove some geometric signatures but do not improve exact match. Decoder-visible JEPA is the first auxiliary to achieve a positive gradient cosine with cross-entropy, yet its exact-match gains remain statistically unresolved under both LoRA and a full fine-tuning replication with n=5 seeds. The important positive finding is that H1 often holds: many auxiliaries do alter curvature, anisotropy, seed variance, or gradient direction. H2 does not reliably follow.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the introduction and the experimental framing around H1 versus H2. Then jump to the main result tables and the multiple-testing analysis. That is enough to understand the central conclusion: representation changes are real, but decoder-visible gains are not robust in this setup. If you have 20–30 minutes, focus on three groups of experiments: BYOL-LLM for JEPA asymmetry, Fisher-metric variants for geometry correction, and decoder-visible JEPA for gradient alignment. Read the hidden-state geometry and gradient-cosine analyses only if you want to judge whether a similar auxiliary might still be useful in a different training regime.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验结果部分即可，计划测试JEPA类预训练目标的团队可参考其阴性结论。
recommendation.en: Only read the experiment section, reference the negative results if you plan to test JEPA-style pretraining objectives.
